items.question: Under the MSA, does Harrowgate have to tell Voss-Lindqvist about a change of control before it happens, or is notice afterwards enough?
items.answer:

The Master Services Agreement (MSA) defines "Change of Control" as a transaction where a person or group acquires more than fifty percent (50%) of the voting rights of the Provider [6: "Change of Control" means any transaction by which a person or group acquires more than fifty percent (50%) of the voting rights of Provider].

The MSA also states that any notice under the Agreement must be in writing and addressed to the General Counsel of the receiving party [2]. However, the MSA does not specify when such notice must be given in relation to a change of control.

items.question: What obligations does Crestmoor take on under the Unit 7 lease?
items.answer:
The documents state that Crestmoor Estates Ltd is the Landlord under the Unit 7 lease [1].

The lease requires the Tenant to keep the interior of the Premises in good and substantial repair [5]. It also requires the Landlord to keep the structure and roof of the Premises in repair [5].

The Tenant must reimburse the Landlord for the insurance premium within 21 days of demand [5].

The Tenant may end the lease on 31 March 2030 by giving six months' prior written notice, provided all rent is paid [6].

The lease is governed by the law of England and Wales [2].

evidence.quote: This Lease is made on 20 March 2025 between **Crestmoor Estates Ltd** (the "Landlord") and **Voss-Lindqvist Logistics Ltd** (the "Tenant")
The Tenant shall keep the interior of the Premises in good and substantial repair
The Landlord shall keep the structure and roof of the Premises in repair
The Landlord shall insure the building and the Tenant shall reimburse the Landlord for the insurance premium within twenty-one (21) days of demand
The Tenant may end this Lease on 31 March 2030 by giving the Landlord at least six (6) months' prior written notice, provided that the Tenant has paid all rent due up to that date
This Lease is governed by the law of England and Wales
